text: くさに　よわい　のは　みず　タイプ　だけ　じゃ　ないわ　じめん　タイプ　と　いわ　タイプも　わたし　たちの　えじきよ！

structure.jp: くさに　よわい　のは
structure.en: the ones that are weak to Grass

structure.jp: みず　タイプ　だけ　じゃ　ないわ
じめん　タイプ　と　いわ　タイプも
structure.en: Ground types and Rock types too

structure.jp: わたし　たちの　えじきよ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: くさに　よわい　のは
patterns.explanation: の after a describing phrase stands in for 'the one' or 'the ones', so the phrase can be talked about like a thing. くさに　よわい　のは = 'the ones that are weak to Grass'.

patterns.name: 〜だけではない
patterns.span: だけ　じゃ　ないわ
patterns.explanation: だけ is 'only' and じゃない is 'is not', so together they say 'is not the only one'. じゃ is the everyday short form of では. みず　タイプ　だけ　じゃ　ない = 'it's not only Water types'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone and adds no meaning of its own. だけ　じゃ　ないわ = 'it's not only them, you know'.
